title: Dublin was a new and complex sensation. Uncle Charles had grown so witless
html_source:
The changes in his life are starting to come about as Uncle Charles becomes a senile old man after being one of Stephen’s close companions at a younger age. This shows the changes that every young boy goes through in boyhood as people change.

No one is made better off by someone becoming senile.
